prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence remains thin for single-test categories (choose_path hint, choose_path layout, finish copy, finish hint, finish new_flow, finish redesign, home notification, home redesign, sign_in copy, sign_in notification, and sign_in reorder).
For choose_path copy changes (2 tests) and choose_path redesign changes (2 tests), no clear effect was seen in any test.
For home wait_info changes (4 tests), no winning effect was demonstrated, with three showing no clear effect and one rolled back due to a guardrail.
For adoption redesign (3 tests) and sign_in hint (2 tests), results disagree and lack a reliable winning pattern, as each had only one winning test.
Predictions were consistently overly optimistic compared to noise-corrected measurements across most tests.

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Split Column Companion Customization Redesign: Redesign the pick_friend screen into a split-column layout, showcasing live companion previews on one side and customization controls on the other. (why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate in the main setup steps (66.2%) and a long mean duration of 1017s.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Companion Interaction Sandbox Screen: Add a dedicated interactive sandbox screen right before home_intro where users practice pet controls, hiding gestures, and chat commands. (why: Support receives multiple emails regarding confusion over how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after onboarding.)
2: [home, new_flow] Interactive Desktop Setup Companion Flow: Introduce a two-column desktop preparation workflow on the waiting screen with interactive setup tasks while companion assets generate. (why: The waiting phase has a high mean duration of 2336s, and support reported users whose pets did not show up on desktop.)
3: [adoption, incentive] Adoption Milestone Celebration Badge: Add an unlocked official adoption badge component to the adoption certificate screen to mark companion ownership. (why: Adoption drops off significantly at 66.2% conversion; celebrating progress provides positive reinforcement.)
4: [home, wait_info] Interactive Companion Care Tips Ticker: Show automatically rotating pet care tips and desktop shortcut tips on the waiting screen. (why: Home waiting step takes a mean time of 2336s and users later email support asking how to operate desktop controls.)
5: [home, notification] Desktop Launch Notification Prompt: Enable desktop notification alerts on the waiting screen so users get notified immediately when asset generation finishes. (why: 3 support tickets report pet not showing up or app not opening, likely due to users switching away during long waits.)
6: [finish, copy] Desktop Quick Control Instructions Copy: Update the home_intro headline and body to give explicit instructions on dragging, hiding, and chatting with the pet. (why: 3 support emails explicitly reported confusion over how to control, hide, or talk to the pet post-onboarding.)
7: [choose_path, layout] Choose Path Compact Step Counter View: Switch the choose_path screen layout to compact mode with progress indicator enabled. (why: Improves clarity on remaining onboarding steps to reduce hesitation during early path choice.)
